We are still tracking a solid $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, Amazon’s pre-order discount on the new Apple TV 4K, and up to $200 off the new Mac Studio and M6 Mac mini. However, today is iPhone Duo launch day so we are featuring a series of discounts on add-on gear like Apple Pencil USB-C as low as $61 (more details here), some exclusive discounts on some of our favorite new leather cases as well as other models from just $14, and this launch deal on the best new Qi2 iPhone Duo MagSafe power bank yet. Check it all out below.

Upgrade your iPhone Duo setup with a fresh set of AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off

The new 2026 iPhone Pro lineup has arrived, iPhone Duo (hands-on review right here) will begin shipping tomorrow, and aside from maybe scoring a new case to keep them safe, AirPods Pro 3 remain the best accessory for any iPhone if you ask me. I love the idea of adding some tracking capabilities with AirTag 2, but AirPods Pro 3 are still the most useful and actively functional add-on there is and you can still score them at $50 off via Amazon.

Amazon is currently Apple’s latest and greatest in-ear experience down at $199 shipped – AirPods Pro carry a $249 list price and they are currently $50 off.

Land iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) as low as $61 at Amazon

Official Apple Pencil support for Apple’s new foldable is actually landing well ahead of schedule – you will need Apple Pencil (USB-C) to make use of it though.

Apple Pencil (USB-C) is the only model iPhone Duo will support starting next week – your Apple Pencil Pro or Apple Pencil 2 will not work.

Fortunately, Amazon is offering Apple Pencil (USB-C) down at $69 shipped right now, or 13% under the regular $79 list price.

And you can score one for even less by way of Amazon Used: Like New listings.

Head over to this page, and select “Other sellers on Amazon” link below the Add to Cart button – this is where you’ll find the best quality Used: Like New option down at $61.29 shipped.

Amazon’s 2026 Apple TV 4K pre-order discount is still live

Unlike the new Apple HomeView, it looks like Amazon is actually going to be holding on to the early Unlike the new Apple HomeView, it looks like Amazon is actually going to be holding on to the early pre-order discount on the new Apple TV 4K for now. But you might want to get in there sooner than later before the delivery times slip even further.

As of the time of writing, Amazon is still delivering the brand new Apple TV 4K down at $289.99 shipped.

  • NEW Apple TV 4K $289 (Reg. $299)

That’s clearly not a massive deal and you could just score the new Siri Remote for a fraction of the price to upgrade your existing Apple TV setup instead, but the light deal is indeed still live as of this morning.

The full price pre-order listing directly from Apple has slipped even further on our end, as it is now no longer able to deliver the new Apple TV 4K until the first week of December.

Amazon is offering it for less, but it appears its delivery times have slipped as well for most regions of the country – you will need to actually checkout to receive a confirmation email with the estimated delivery time to find out by just how much.

Not exactly an easy choice, but you can leverage the slightly lower price on Amazon and then cancel the order if you don’t like the estimated arrival time you get.

Apple’s new Mac Studio and M6 Mac mini models are up to $200 off right now

The fall Prime Day that landed earlier this month ushered some impressive price drops on Apple’s new headless Macs – the M6 Mac mini and the latest Mac Studio. While not all of those discounts are still available, some of the best of them still are with up to $200 slashed from the list prices.

The M6 Mac mini is likely a far more universally appealing pickup, and there are still a couple particularly notable discounts live there, but we are starting with the straight up $200 price drop on the new Mac Studio.

Amazon is carrying the most affordable configuration this generation, and that means we are in for some solid discounts unlike years past. As of right now, we are still tracking the 36GB/512GB model with the 18-core CPU and 32-core GPU down at $2,299 shipped.

This is a regularly $2,499 machine with a solid $200 price drop to delivery the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon to date – this is the same deal Amazon offered for the fall Prime Day sale this year.

As for the M6 Mac mini, the two most affordable configurations Amazon offers are still sitting with deep discounts right now. This includes the entry 16GB/256GB model at $120 off and the 16GB/512GB model at $949.99 – that’s $149 off the list price and within $1 of the lowest price we have tracked to date:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099)

Best Qi2 iPhone Duo MagSafe power bank yet is back – now up for grabs at $60 [Launch deal]

Baseus has unleashed a new brand-new Picogo Air MagSafe power bank purpose-built for the iPhone Duo, and it’s now up for grabs via the brand’s official storefront for $59.99 shipped when you enter promo code PICOGO72F during checkout. This is a brand new model that just hit the scene for the iPhone Duo delivery day, and you can now snag it with a nice launch deal at $20 off. It’s one of the very few MagSafe power banks that’ll pair nicely with Apple’s new foldable, and you can learn more about it in detail.

The new PicoGo Air AM72 is a 5,000mAh Qi2 power bank made specifically for the iPhone Duo’s shorter and wider form factor. Baseus says it offers a 1:1 fit that stays clear of the camera while sitting neatly against the back of the phone. It measures just 7.9mm at its thinnest point and uses an aluminum-alloy shell, keeping the whole package pretty slim and premium to the touch. This model supports up to 15W Qi2 magnetic charging and has a USB-C port that delivers up to 25W for faster wired top-ups. Baseus even includes a short Type-C cable in the box to go with this unit for wired charging.

There’s also NFC support on this model through Baseus’ PowerSense system, similar to what we first saw on the PicoGo Air AM71. It lets you pull up useful information like battery health, remaining capacity, and other charging details directly on your iPhone, giving you a bit more insight into what the power bank is doing without adding a screen to the pack itself.

My favorite 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger: Anker Prime 25W now nearly 35% off

We featured the most recent price drop on the latest Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger at nearly 35% off, and today we are highlighting the same deal on the white model. You can indeed land my personal favorite option in the Phantom Gray treatment (a sort of Space Gray vibe) at the same discounted rate, but for those with a penchant for the light, bright, and minimalist, the Radiant White model is at the ready.

The official Anker Amazon storefront is now offering its Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger down at $99.73 shipped – this includes the both the Radiant White and the Phantom Gray models.

Regularly $150, you’re looking at just shy of 35% in savings here. This deal its on par with just about every discount we have seen since this model released earlier this year, save for the one-time low at roughly $5 less for fall Prime Day.

Extremely rare deal knocks nearly $50 off Apple’s 512GB MacBook Neo

This will likely not last for long folks, but Amazon just dropped the price on the 512GB MacBook Neo in Citrus – it is now approaching $50 off.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s MacBook Neo with the 512GB storage capacity and the Touch ID keyboard down to $756 shipped.

This is a regularly $799 machine these days and is now only $43 off the list price, but deals on MacBook Neo are somewhere between extremely rare and non-existent. Even before the price hike there were basically no straight up cash discounts outside of a light $9 or $10 off.

The Neo did receive a price increase back in late June, jumping up $100 from the original listing, but again this is a wildly rare price drop and one that likely will not stick around for long.

THe next best option is to go refurbished straight from the official Apple refurb store where this machine is sitting at $679:

  • Apple Refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB w/ Touch ID $679 (Reg. $799 new)

Popular new Airfly Drive CarPlay/Android Auto adapter back in-stock, delivery times starting to slip

Some of the hottest tech releases and pre-orders of the last couple months have sold out very quickly with delivery times get pushed well beyond release date, not unlike the new Apple HomeView and Twelve South’s new Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay and Android Auto adapter. The $40 Airfly Drive has been one of the most popular pickups around here and you might want to consider locking one in now before delivery times slip into December (or later).

Apple’s 2026 all-glyph Magic Keyboard is sitting at the Amazon all-time low (Nearly 20% off)

Alongside the up to $150 price drops on the new M6 Mac mini, another one of the more impressive fall Prime Day hangover deals still live, that also happens to be the perfect companion piece, is Apple’s new Magic Keyboard – it is sitting at the Amazon all-time low right now.

Amazon is now offering the 2026 Apple Magic Keyboard down at $79.99 shipped.
